role: Complete only the two preoutcome stability gates that remain unresolved: leave-one-realm-out positive G1 excess for every estimable realm and leave-one-major-family-out positive G1 excess for every estimable major family.

known_existing_failed_gate.consequence: Even if every leave-out excess is positive, the full original strong-stability claim remains not passed.

metadata_source.provenance: Outcome-blind independent GBIF taxon/occurrence and realm metadata frozen by the prospective G5 metadata stage before any G5 colour outcome was opened.

realm.assignment: exact nonempty dominant_realm string from frozen G5 species metadata
realm.missing_assignment: species with missing dominant_realm remains in every realm leave-out and is never assigned post hoc
realm.estimable: at least one of the 369 inferential species is assigned to the realm; after omission at least 5 distinct species remain available somewhere and at least one primary grid cell is evaluable under the unchanged support>=5 rule

major_family.assignment: exact nonempty accepted_family string from frozen G5 GBIF taxon metadata
major_family.major_definition: family count among all 369 inferential species is at least ceil(0.05*369)=19; denominator remains 369 even if some species have missing family metadata
major_family.missing_assignment: species with missing accepted_family remains in every family leave-out and is never assigned post hoc
major_family.estimable: family meets the fixed >=19-species definition and at least one primary grid cell remains evaluable after omission

leaveout_operation.outer_schedule: reuse the exact frozen 200 x 250-species x 20-photo schedule; do not redraw or replace an omitted species
leaveout_operation.operation: Within each frozen outer realization, remove all edge-kernel contributions of scheduled species belonging to the omitted group. All retained species keep their original scheduled photos, kNN graph, within-species edge ranks, species-total weight, kernel geometry and null colour assignment.
leaveout_operation.support_mask: recompute the outer distinct-species support after group removal and require >=5 retained species; do not retain cells solely because they were evaluable in the full dataset
leaveout_operation.consensus: aggregate retained observed/null edge numerators and retained opportunities over the same 200 outers, only where that leave-out outer cell satisfies the unchanged support rule
leaveout_operation.statistic: same aggregate-opportunity-weighted variance of consensus field as primary G1

null_and_gate.descriptive_p_role: reported only for scale; not a confirmatory gate and cannot rescue primary G1
null_and_gate.no_multiplicity_claim: No family/realm leave-out p-value is interpreted as a new hypothesis test.

claim_ceiling: Can complete the prespecified leave-out component of the G1 robustness audit. It cannot change p=0.070 primary no-support, and because the predeclared 100-vs-200 stability gate already failed, it cannot by itself establish the original full strong-stability claim.
